entities.name: Raddic

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Raided and stripped by the Talites.

events.summary: A Talite procession reaches Penregon and issues an ultimatum after attacking an automaton.
events.quote: cast out the machines or face destruction

events.summary: Penregon repels the Talites' assault and defeats Raddic's infiltrators.
events.quote: Penregon's defenders successfully repelled the Talite crusaders' assault on the city walls

events.summary: The Second Talite Crusade raids Urza's Tower and fights at Mishra's Forge, where Raddic dies.
events.quote: many of the faithful, including Raddic, were killed in the brutal conflict
